fullDescription: A high-tech, futuristic dark-mode design system with a 'Ghost' aesthetic, utilizing glassmorphism, neon gradients, and celestial background elements. It features a space-inspired color palette (#0a0e27), high-contrast typography (Space Grotesk), and sophisticated micro-interactions like shimmering code blocks and pulsing status indicators. Ideal for privacy-focused SaaS, cybersecurity, fintech, or ephemeral messaging applications that require a premium, secure, and modern feel.

structured.summary: Create a secure, dark-themed room creation interface for an ephemeral communication platform. Use a deep navy background (#0a0e27) with glassmorphic cards, vibrant purple-to-pink gradients, and animated celestial elements to evoke a sense of privacy and high technology.

style.description: The style is defined by its 'Cyber-Security' aesthetic: a dark base with layered transparency and neon accents. Typography uses 'Space Grotesk' for a technical yet modern look. Colors include a primary gradient from #a855f7 to #ec4899, set against a background of #0a0e27. Shadows are used as glows rather than depth markers. Layout relies on large border-radii (up to 3rem) and significant whitespace to maintain clarity despite the complex background.
style.prompt: Apply a global style using 'Space Grotesk' as the primary font family. Set the background to #0a0e27. Implement glassmorphism using a combination of `bg-white/[0.03]`, `backdrop-blur-[20px]`, and `border-white/10`. Use a vibrant gradient from #a855f7 to #ec4899 for primary actions and highlights. Include a 'text-glow' effect using `text-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)`. Animations should include: 1. A slow pulsing glow for background blobs (scale 1 to 1.1, opacity 0.3 to 0.5 over 8s). 2. A 5s floating effect for icons (translateY -10px). 3. A 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) slide-up entry for all main containers. 4. A 3.2s linear shimmer effect for code blocks using a 90-degree gradient shift.

layout_and_structure.description: A vertically centered, single-column layout optimized for focused user actions. It consists of a top navigation bar, a central high-impact hero card, and a footer containing trust signals.

prompts.prompt: Create a multi-layered background. The base is #0a0e27. Add three large, blurred blobs: top-left (purple-900/10, blur 120px, 8s pulse), bottom-right (pink-900/10, blur 120px, 8s pulse), and middle-right (indigo-900/10, blur 100px, 8s pulse). Overlay an interactive constellation or star-field component for depth.

Design a wide header (max-width: 5xl) with a logo group on the left: a 44x44px rounded-xl icon with a gradient (#a855f7 to #ec4899) and a floating animation. On the right, place a 'Go back' link styled as a low-profile glassmorphic pill (bg-white/5, border-white/10, px-4, py-3) that shifts the icon on hover.

Center a 3xl max-width container. The main card uses `rounded-[3rem]`, `p-10` to `p-14`, and a glassmorphic style (bg-white/0.03, backdrop-blur-20px, border-white/10). Inside, include a centered layout starting with a small pill badge for security status (e.g., 'Ephemeral room'), followed by a 3xl semi-bold heading and a subtle gray-400 subtext.

Inside the card, place a secondary container (max-width: xl) with `rounded-[2.5rem]`, `bg-white/5`, and a shimmer animation. Layout should be a flex-row (stacking on mobile) featuring a large, high-tracking code display (font-size 6xl, tracking 0.2em) and a group of 'Copy' buttons. The copy button should have a hidden gradient background that reveals on hover with a large glow shadow.

prompts.prompt: Below the code block, place a 'waiting' status indicator with a pinging dot (#ec4899) and a cycling ellipsis animation. Follow this with a two-column grid of buttons: one primary action with a gradient hover reveal and shadow-glow, and one secondary ghost-style button with white/5 background and white/10 border.

Create a footer with a series of rounded-full pills. Each pill should have a thin border (white/5), a slight blur, and an icon with a unique pastel accent color (purple-400, pink-400, indigo-400). Arrange them in a centered flex row with a slide-up entrance animation.

special_ui_components.description: A glassmorphic button that transforms into a glowing gradient on hover.
special_ui_components.prompt: Implement a button with `position: relative`, `overflow: hidden`, and `isolate`. Set `bg-white/5` and `border-white/10` as the default. Create a pseudo-element or inner div with a gradient (`from-[#a855f7] to-[#ec4899]`) and `z-index: -1`. On hover, transition the opacity of the gradient from 0 to 1 and add `box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(168,85,247,0.7)`. Use a 300ms transition duration.

special_ui_components.description: A focused container for sensitive codes with an animated light streak.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a container with a 90-degree linear-gradient shimmer overlay (`transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.08), transparent`). The shimmer should animate from `translateX(-120%)` to `120%` every 3.2 seconds. Ensure the room code text inside uses `tracking-[0.2em]` and a heavy font weight for maximum legibility.

special_ui_components.description: A pulse-and-text combination to indicate live background processes.
special_ui_components.prompt: Combine a `span` with `animate-ping` for a subtle outward ring effect with a static dot in the center (#ec4899). Adjacent text should include a three-dot ellipsis animation ('...', '..', '.', '') using a CSS keyframe `waitingDots` that cycles content over 1.2s.
